T: › [ T ] formal to cause difficulty and problems for someone or something
困擾，使苦惱；使處境困難

I or T: › [ I or T ] old-fashioned to be ill, or to cause to be ill

example: The government seems to have no understanding of what ails the country.
政府好像不了解國家問題的癥結所在。
She had been ailing for years before she died.
她去世前幾年就一直病魔纏身。

NONE: › a part along the back edge of an aircraft's wing that can be moved to help the aircraft turn or to keep it level
境況不佳的，處境困難的；不景氣的

example: Ted asked me if I could help him fix his ailing car.
特德的車壞了，他問我是否可以幫他修理一下。
一點兒小毛病可以自己治。
